query_text: Need a mobile app that helps me find good iron and plant-based protein sources so I stop guessing at the grocery store. I eat mostly plants and I always forget which foods actually have decent iron or protein in them. The app should let me tap a food and instantly see how much iron and protein it has per serving, plus maybe group things by category like legumes, seeds, and greens so I can plan my meals without doing math in my head.

Build a calcium and bone health food tracker for my phone that makes it easy to log what I ate and see if I actually hit my calcium goals that day. I keep forgetting which foods count toward bone health and end up not knowing if I got enough. The tracker should let me tap to add foods, show me the calcium amount for each one, and give me a simple daily total so I can tell at a glance whether I need to eat more dairy or leafy greens before the day is over.

Build a hydrating food reference app for my phone that tells me the water content of common fruits and vegetables so I can stop guessing which ones actually help with hydration. I always forget that cucumbers and watermelon are basically water, and I want to be able to tap a food and see the percentage right away. It should have a simple list I can browse quickly and show me the top hydrating options so I can pick them at the store without thinking too hard.

Create a pre and post workout snack guide app for my phone that stops me from eating the wrong thing before the gym and then wondering why I feel sluggish. I need it to be split into before and after sections so I can tap the right one depending on where I am in my workout, and each snack suggestion should include roughly what to eat and why it helps, kept simple so I can read it in under a minute and just get on with my day.

Need a mobile app that highlights seasonal superfoods and what makes them worth eating so I actually know what to grab at the farmers market each season. I keep seeing stuff like elderberries or purslane and having no clue if they are worth buying. The app should show me what is in season right now, list the main nutrients or benefits for each one in plain words, and let me tap through without getting buried in long articles.

Need a per-serving calorie count lookup tool for my phone because I can never remember how many calories are in a normal portion of something and I end up either overeating or stressing out. I want to be able to type in a food name and get the calorie count for one standard serving right away, no scrolling through long nutrition panels. It should also let me set my own serving size if the standard one does not match what I actually eat, so the number I see is actually useful.

Need a fermentation and preservation recipe guide app for my phone that collects recipes for things like kimchi, pickles, and fermented hot sauce all in one place. I want to be able to browse by type of ferment, see ingredient lists, and get clear step-by-step instructions with timing so I know when to check on things. It would also be great if it could show me how long each batch needs to ferment and let me save the ones I want to try later.

A vegan complete amino acid protein combo guide for my phone, organized by food pairings like rice and beans or hummus and pita, so I can see at a glance which combinations give me all the essential amino acids I need. Each pairing should have a short note explaining why it works and a simple example meal, and I want to be able to tap through them quickly without wading through dense nutrition science text.

Need a restaurant copycat recipe app for my phone that lets me search for dishes from popular places and get a home version I can actually make. I want to be able to type in something like a specific sauce or menu item, get a recipe with real ingredient amounts, and see a rough estimate of how long it takes. It should also let me save my favorites so I can come back to them without searching all over again.

Create a cocktail and mocktail ingredient pairing app for my phone that helps me figure out what flavors and mixers go well together when I am trying to come up with a new drink at home. I want to tap an ingredient I already have, like lime or ginger, and see a list of things that pair nicely with it along with a couple of example drinks. It should cover both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options so I can use it whether I am making something for myself or for guests who skip alcohol.

Create a sourdough and bread baking guide app for my phone that walks me through the whole process from feeding my starter to the final bake, because I always lose track of timing and mess up the rise. I want step-by-step instructions for a few different bread types, clear notes on how long each stage takes, and a place to log when I started each step so I do not have to do the time math in my head while I am covered in flour.

An ingredient flavor profile pairing chart app for my phone that shows me which flavors go well together so I can stop second-guessing myself in the kitchen. I want to tap an ingredient and see a short list of things that pair with it, organized by flavor type like sweet, savory, or acidic, so I can make something new without following a recipe exactly. The app should be quick to use since I usually check it mid-cook when my hands are busy.

Need a cold and warm food advisory guide app for my phone that tells me which foods are considered warming or cooling and how they affect the body, so I can make better choices depending on the season or how I am feeling. I want to be able to look up a specific food or browse by category, and get a plain-language explanation of whether it is warming, cooling, or neutral along with a note on when to eat more or less of it.

Need a 30-minute weeknight dinner generator app for my phone that suggests meals I can actually finish in half an hour on a busy night. I want to put in a few ingredients I already have and get a recipe that fits the time limit, with clear steps and a quick ingredient list. It should also let me filter by things like vegetarian or no-fish so the results actually match what my household eats.

A critic vs user review comparison app for my phone where I can look up a restaurant and see both the professional critic score and the regular customer rating side by side, so I can tell if the hype is real or just for fancy food people. Each listing should show a short summary of what critics loved versus what everyday diners actually said, with enough detail to decide if it is worth going. The layout should feel clean and easy to tap through when I am standing outside deciding where to eat.

A dish photo gallery app for my phone that lets restaurants or users post beautiful photos of specific dishes so I can browse by dish name and actually see what I am ordering before I get there. Each dish should have its own gallery with a few photos, the restaurant name, and a short note on what makes it special, all laid out so I can swipe through photos quickly on a small screen and get a real feel for the food.

A takeout and delivery option toggle app for my phone that shows me which nearby restaurants offer pickup, delivery, or both, so I can quickly filter based on what I feel like doing tonight. The main screen should let me switch between takeout and delivery with one tap, then show a list of places with estimated times and a rough price range, keeping it simple so I can decide fast and place my order without jumping between multiple apps.

Need a food allergy communication card generator app for my phone that lets me create a simple card listing my allergies so I can show it to restaurant staff when I travel or go somewhere where the language barrier makes ordering stressful. I want to pick my allergens from a list, add any notes in plain language, and generate something I can pull up on my phone screen to hand to the server. It should look clean enough that people actually take it seriously.

Need a mobile app that tells the story and history of well-known restaurants, like when they were founded, what made them famous, and how they have changed over the years. I love knowing the background of a place before I visit because it makes the whole experience feel richer. The app should feel like a good read, with a warm and inviting tone, photos where possible, and the stories organized so I can easily jump between different restaurants and cities.

Make a menu price trend alert app for my phone that tracks how much dishes at my favorite restaurants have changed in price over time, so I can notice when something I order regularly has quietly gotten more expensive. The app should let me save a list of dishes I care about, show me a simple price history, and send me a notice when a price jumps by a noticeable amount. The whole thing should feel light and easy to check on my phone without a lot of setup.

Build a community dining event app for my phone that lets people find and join group dinners or pop-up meals happening at local venues, with a warm and social feel like you are being invited somewhere special. Each event listing should show the venue, the menu theme, how many seats are left, and a bit of atmosphere description so I can tell if it matches the vibe I am looking for. I want it to feel inviting and easy to browse through on my phone when I am looking for something fun to do this weekend.

Create a Michelin star restaurant city guide app for my phone that helps me plan a food trip by showing me starred restaurants organized by city, with enough detail to understand what makes each one unique. I want it to feel visually appealing and refined, with each restaurant having a short write-up about the cuisine and atmosphere so I can picture myself there. It should be easy to filter by city or star level so I can quickly build a shortlist for wherever I am traveling next.

Need a famous painting and artist attribution quiz app for my phone that I can use to test myself and a few friends when we are bored. The idea is to show a painting and ask who made it or which era it is from, and then reveal the answer with a short fun fact about the artist. It would be great if it tracked our scores across rounds and had enough paintings in the mix that we do not see the same ones every time we play.

Need a logo and brand recognition quiz app for my phone that my coworkers and I can use to challenge each other during lunch. The app should show a logo, sometimes with the name hidden, and ask me to identify the brand or pick the right answer from a few options. It should keep score across rounds and cover logos from a range of industries like tech, food, sports, and fashion so it stays interesting and does not feel like it is testing the same brands every single time.

Need a sports stat and record trivia app for my phone that my friends and I can use to settle debates about who holds what record or which team had the best season. I want it to ask me questions about historical stats and records across different sports, show the correct answer with a bit of context, and track how well I do over time. It should cover multiple sports so there is something for everyone in the group and the questions feel varied rather than all from one league.
